events.title: Update 5: new bodywork
events.summary: The physics has worn a tuxedo since day one. The graphics showed up in pajamas, then turned the lights off, and last time finally put on factory paint. Turns out paint doesn't help much when what's underneath is a cardboard box with wheels. The cardboard boxes are finally gone. In the pictures below: old on the left, new on the right. events.title: Steam Next Fest: the starting lights are on
events.summary: Steam Next Fest has started, and TapRacer is on the grid. At night, with the headlights on, and for the first time in the right colours. If you haven't tried it yet: TapRacer is a drag racer where your throttle is two keys, tapped in strict alternation. How fast you tap is how far the throttle opens. events.title: Update 4: factory fresh
events.summary: Until yesterday every car in TapRacer rolled off the line in the same deep red. The hatchback, the van, the sedan. All red. For a game that reads lamp catalogues from the nineties for its physics, that was embarrassing. Last time the graphics turned the lights off so nobody would notice the pajamas. Now they've actually changed. Into exactly the colours you could order at the dealer. And because that wasn't enough, 289 custom colours for body, wheels and brake calipers are waiting on top. events.title: Update 3: lights out, headlights on
events.summary: Well, that escalated quickly. A few days ago a Reddit comment asked me to "tone down the bright grass". I went looking for the grass and found too much light. Then the night. Then a new colour space. Then headlights for every car. The grass is darker now, by the way. Last time the physics was wearing a tuxedo and the graphics showed up in pajamas. events.title: Update 2: new race track and physics stand 3
events.summary: From today the demo races on a new track. With it comes a new physics stand. IN THE DEMO Race Track Update 1The quarter mile is rebuilt: road surface, kerbs, barriers, garages and hills in the background. An arch with the TapRacer lettering stands at the start. Clutch and launchThe clutch no longer snaps shut in one hit; its clamp pressure builds up over a moment. Drop the clutch without gas and you hear only a short, quiet chirp.
